assets.prompt: Simple unpretentious late Joseon Korean painting inspired by Shin Yun-bok's Miindo: extremely fine sparse dark ink contour lines, flat pale ivory and dusty blue-gray washes, restrained pigment, large undecorated surfaces, minimal folds, humble countryside feeling. NOT photorealistic, NOT ornate, no flowers, no jewelry, no gold, no rich embroidery, no gradients or glow, no cast shadow, no text or backdrop. Fully transparent PNG background, clear generous transparent margins. One adult Korean fairy woman SEEN FROM BEHIND, seated chest-deep in a small flattened oval of quiet pale jade water. She wears a simple opaque ivory bathing gown covering shoulders, back and torso, loose plain sleeves just above water. Her upper body is HALF SUBMERGED: only head, shoulders and upper half of back above the waterline. Simple single black hair bun tied with a small dark ribbon, face hidden, no looking at camera. Calm modest pose with hands resting just at water surface. Small compact water ellipse of only 3 thin ink ripple lines, not a large dramatic splash. Head and shoulders readable and unobstructed. Design for a tiny game sprite.
